content: Plan comparator decision recorded: reuse=True, restart_at_step=2. The new plan is a more detailed and refined version of the old plan. The first step (Data Acquisition) is largely covered by the old step 1, although the new plan adds a verification step. The second step (Pre-processing and Tracer Integration) is a refinement of the old step 2. The subsequent steps in the new plan (FTLE, Scaling, Anisotropy, Trapping, Statistical Rigor) break down the old steps 3 and 4 into more granular, specific tasks. Since the core data processing and analysis logic is being redefined with more specific requirements (e.g., minimum image convention, specific thresholds), it is safer to restart from the data processing phase to ensure consistency across all metrics. I will reuse the data acquisition step (Step 1) as it is functionally equivalent, and restart from Step 2 to ensure the new, more rigorous integration and analysis methods are applied consistently.
